facts.fact: StackAdapt's Page Context AI can target ad placements across 400 million pages, according to the vendor's page.
facts.quote: You’re in the driver’s seat—in control of identifying where you want your native, display and video ads to appear across 400 million pages.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that its historical analysis shows placing ads in the right context can increase user engagement by a factor of up to 4 to 10.
facts.quote: Our historical analysis has shown that placing ads in the right context can increase user engagement by a factor of up to 4 to 10.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Page Context AI is protected by a US patent, number 11,748,776, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: StackAdapt’s patented algorithm (US patent 11,748,776) can determine the best ad placements

facts.fact: StackAdapt says Page Context AI does not depend on cookies or other identifiers, so it can reach relevant consumers without personal information.
facts.quote: Page Context AI—which does not depend on cookies or other identifiers—is an effective way to reach relevant consumers without the need for personal information.

facts.fact: StackAdapt says Page Context AI is not limited by a pre-built taxonomy, allowing advertisers to specify custom contexts.
facts.quote: As Page Context AI is not limited by a pre-built taxonomy, it gives you the control to specify your desired, unique context.

facts.fact: StackAdapt says advertisers can verify ads served on relevant domains both pre-flight and in-flight with Page Context AI.
facts.quote: Page Context AI allows you to verify your ads served on relevant domains pre- and in-flight.
